x: Simon Vella, Gavin Jones, John Wilson and Adam Jones all performed very well in each match. In the Surrey League our combined Youths/Boys team had no opposition all year.
In the Junior Boys age group Simon Alexander was 241st for Surrey and Gavin Jones 243rd for Sussex. We believe Simon Vella ran for London but can't find his name among the results.

The Kent Championships saw Nigel Whorlow come home 34th and in Sussex, Gavin Jones was 9th in 15:07. No fewer than eight of our lads were selected to represent their counties in the Inter-Counties event.
In the U15 age group, we again had a winning double from Gavin Jones and Gavin Walsh in the 1500m and also in the U15 we won both pole vault strings thanks to Andrew Hill and Stevie Scott.
Left: Gavin Jones ran a personal best of 4:29.9 to win the 1500 metres at Deangate, a performance that made him our top under 15 for the event in 1993.
Sussex based Gavin Jones was in the pack after the first circuit, handing over to a determined James Drake and we were up to 9th by mid-way.
In the U15 1500m, Gavin Jones and Gavin Walsh won the A and B strings respectively and in the U13 100m, Warren Stewart and Duncan Thompson also both won their strings.
